Meet Kyle Wipf

About Kyle Wipf

With over ten years helping buyers and sellers in Southern Utah and across the state, Kyle works with sellers, buyers, new construction, investors, probate, and vacation rentals. He spent 25 years in building materials before becoming an agent, so he understands construction — not just contracts.

Kyle treats clients like lifelong friends. In St. George he partners with Webb Custom Homes on custom builds, and markets with staging, professional photography, and broad reach so homes show at their best.

A family man with nine children, Kyle enjoys sailing, scuba diving, anything outdoors, and good food. His approach is simple: pursue passions fearlessly, and treat every setback as a comeback opportunity.

Why clients choose Kyle

I’m one agent you can reach, with Remax Associates and Diamond Group Real Estate behind me. Clear communication. Honest pricing. No pressure — built for buyers and sellers who care about quality, including homes at $500,000 and above.

Southern Utah specialist, serving all of Utah

I live and work in St. George, and Southern Utah is my specialty: St. George, Washington, Hurricane, Santa Clara, Ivins, Cedar City, and the communities around them. I know the neighborhoods, desert construction, and how relocation and second-home buyers think. I’m also glad to work anywhere in the state, north to south, from Southern Utah to the Wasatch Front and Northern Utah.

What “best real estate agent in St. George” should mean

Skip the slogans. Look for:

  • Clear communication and response time
  • Honest pricing and negotiation advice
  • Local knowledge — HOAs, desert construction, commute patterns
  • Real marketing: photography, staging, online reach
  • A brokerage name and license you can verify

That’s the standard I hold myself to.
